responsibility: This declarative definition file is the master list of supported M68K and ColdFire devices. Each M68K_DEVICE entry records the user-visible -mcpu name, target_device enum value, representative family and multilib device, associated microarchitecture and ISA, and feature flags such as MMU, FPU, MAC, EMAC, hardware divide, or uClinux support. The file is shared by C code and generator scripts, making it the central source for device classification, option decoding, and multilib family selection.
